name: 5977-longdecode-dsv25fp8-tp8
model: A locally produced 128x128 block-wise FP8 copy of deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V2.5-1210 at ${SYSAGENT_DATA}/models/DeepSeek-V2.5-1210-blockfp8 (221 GB). It is a LOCAL ARTIFACT and not a Hub id: a converter writes it from the 471 GB bf16 release.
hardware: 8x H100 80GB HBM3, one node, no router and no external cache tier.
parallelism: TP=8 for attention and the dense path, EXPERT PARALLEL for the MoE path (enable-ep-moe), PP=1, DP=1. EP is forced by the checkpoint: moe_intermediate_size 1536 / 8 = 192 is not a multiple of the 128-wide quantization block, so the block-FP8 path rejects a tensor-sharded expert.
architecture: DeepseekV2ForCausalLM, 236B parameters, 60 layers (1 dense, 59 MoE), hidden 5120, 128 attention heads, Multi-head Latent Attention (q_lora_rank 1536, kv_lora_rank 512, qk_rope_head_dim 64, qk_nope_head_dim 128, v_head_dim 128), 160 routed experts at top-6 plus 2 shared, moe_intermediate_size 1536, fp8 e4m3 with weight_block_size [128, 128].
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=32, warmup the first 20%, bounded at 384 requests with a 2400 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, SINGLE TURN, no prefix buckets, seed 42. Prompts ~512 tokens over [128, 1024] (stdev 192), generations ~1024 tokens over [512, 1536] (stdev 256), temperature 0.0 and ignore_eos true so every request generates its full sampled length.
purpose: A long-form writing assistant on a 236B mixture-of-experts model, 32 concurrent users, thousand-token answers, eight GPUs.
launch:
# Flat `key: value` only -- a nested block is DROPPED by the flat parser and the engine then runs
# without something this file declares.

model-path: ${SYSAGENT_DATA}/models/DeepSeek-V2.5-1210-blockfp8
trust-remote-code: true
tp-size: 8

# Required, not tuning: this checkpoint is block-wise FP8 with a 128x128 block and
# moe_intermediate_size 1536, and 1536 / 8 = 192 is not a multiple of 128, so the block-FP8 path
# rejects a tensor-sharded expert. EP gives each rank 20 whole experts. Attention remains TP8.
enable-ep-moe: true

attention-backend: fa3
context-length: 4096
disable-radix-cache: true
